name: What common home modifications make a house wheelchair accessible?

mainEntity.name: What common home modifications make a house wheelchair accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common wheelchair accessible home modifications include widening doorways to at least 32 inches, installing ramps or lifts for entry and interior level changes, and creating roll-in showers or curbless showers. Other important updates often involve lowering countertops and sinks, installing grab bars in bathrooms, and replacing traditional door handles with lever-style handles. Ensuring clear turning radii in key areas like kitchens and bathrooms is also crucial for ease of movement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications include widening doorways, installing ramps/lifts, roll-in showers, and lowering countertops for easier access.
